Which of these electronic structures are incorrect?
1) 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s¹
2) 1s² 2s² 2p⁷ 3s²
3) 1s² 2s² 2p⁵ 3s¹
4) 1s² 2s³ 2p⁶ 2d¹⁰ 3s²
5) 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁶ 3d¹⁰ 3f⁶
questions.explanation: 2p⁷ (max 6), 2s³/2d (no d sublevel for n = 2) and 3f (no f for n = 3) are impossible. Structure 3 is an excited state but allowed.
